{{Quote|Lord Maul, we must depart immediately.|The pilot|<ref name="The Phantom Apprentice" />}}
A [[Gender|female]] '''pilot''' served the [[Shadow Collective]] criminal organization, led by the rogue [[Sith Lord]] [[Maul]], near the end of the [[Clone Wars]]. During the [[Siege of Mandalore]], the [[pilot]] flew a [[Kom'rk-class fighter/transport|Gauntlet fighter]] to rescue Maul, who was [[Lightsaber duel|dueling]] the former [[Jedi]] [[Padawan]] [[Ahsoka Tano]] in the [[city]] of [[Sundari]]. Maul was unable to reach the [[starfighter]], however, as he was defeated by Tano and captured by the [[Galactic Republic]]. The pilot departed immediately afterwards.<ref name="The Phantom Apprentice" />

{{Char-stub}}

==Behind the scenes==
The pilot first appeared, albeit only through voice, in the ''[[Star Wars: The Clone Wars]]'' episode "[[The Phantom Apprentice]],"<ref name="The Phantom Apprentice" /> which aired on [[April 24]], [[2020]].<ref name="Disney Press Release">{{DisneyPlus|subdomain=press|url=disney-plus/star-wars-the-clone-wars/710|text=Episode 710 "The Phantom Apprentice"}}</ref> The pilot, credited as "Gauntlet Pilot," was voiced by [[Vanessa Marshall]], who also portrayed [[Rook Kast]] in the episode.<ref name="The Phantom Apprentice" />
